solution.name: Abandoned checkout email sequence
solution.metaTitle: Abandoned checkout email sequence — timed to intent
solution.metaDescription: A two-step abandoned checkout email sequence — first message around 1 hour, follow-up around 24 hours — sent automatically from Shopify.
solution.lede: The sequence is the part most stores get wrong: too few messages and the reminder never arrives, too many and the store starts to feel like spam. Whaleal Cart ships with a two-step default and lets you move both windows.

sections.h: Why the first message goes at around one hour
p: The first hour is when the customer still has the cart in mind: the payment step failed, the card was in another room, the decision felt too big in the moment. A message in that window reads as a reminder. The same message at hour twelve reads as marketing.
That is why the default first email is around one hour after abandonment — and why it is configurable for stores whose buying cycle is different.

sections.h: Why there is a second message at all
p: A single reminder catches the customers who were interrupted. The follow-up catches the customers who were deciding. Around twenty-four hours later, the answer to “should I?” is often different from what it was in the moment.
Two messages, not five: the sequence ends there unless you change it. A short sequence that always fires beats a long one that you turn off because it feels aggressive.

Each message is built from a template you control. The template pulls the abandoned cart items, the customer name, the order total and currency, the return link, and any discount code you have attached to the offer.
bullets: Subject, heading and body come from your template
Cart contents, totals and currency are filled from the checkout
One-tap return link takes the customer back to the cart
Optional discount code, if you attach one

sections.h: What AI drafts, and what stays fixed
p: On the paid plans, one click can draft a subject line, a heading and a short intro. You review the draft and switch it on only if you like it; nothing is sent automatically, and you can regenerate or roll back to one of your previous versions.
The customer data, the cart contents, the totals and the links are fixed by the template and the checkout — AI never reads customer or checkout data, and it never writes the full message.
The dashboard reports recovery emails sent, recovered orders and recovered revenue, so the sequence can be judged on orders rather than on opens alone.

faq.q: Can I change the timing of both emails?
faq.a: Yes. The defaults are around one hour and around twenty-four hours; both windows are yours to move, and the sequence can be disabled entirely.

faq.q: Can I run an SMS alongside the emails?
faq.a: Yes — the text channel is optional and independent, with its own send delay. One recovery message per abandoned checkout per channel.

faq.q: Is the Free plan missing the sequence?
faq.a: No. Both recovery channels and the timed sequence are available on the Free plan, up to its monthly abandoned-cart and email limits.
